adjudication.rationale: The finding matches the diff: Jobs::PollFeed#execute calls poll_feed only if three conditions are true (feed_polling_enabled?, feed_polling_url.present?, embed_by_username.present?). In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb the three “requires X” tests each stub only one setting, but the other settings are effectively falsey by default via config/site_settings.yml (feed_polling_enabled: false, feed_polling_url: '', embed_by_username: ''). Therefore poll_feed would still not be called even if the tested condition were removed, so those guard tests don’t actually verify each individual requirement.
